defect: The block_ffm unit tests fail on a current stable rustc: newer compilers surface out-of-bounds reads behind unsafe unchecked indexing in the FFM block, so cargo test block_ffm exits nonzero and the crate's suite has been red since mid-2024 (upstream issue outbrain-inc/fwumious_wabbit#134). The fix must keep the tests' expected outputs; it is the indexing that is wrong, not the expectations.

evidence.notes: Full build pulls intel-mkl-src and takes minutes on first run. Upstream issue #134 names the cause: unsafe indexing that a newer rustc now checks. Expect panics or failed assertions inside the test_ffm_* functions.
